Course overview

One path. Every core Android layer.

Designed for BS Computer Science, ADP Computer Science, and Software Engineering students. Learn with the supplied lectures, working examples, visual demonstrations, and quizzes.

What you will learn

  • Write clear Kotlin programs using control flow, collections, classes, and constructors.
  • Design Android interfaces in XML and connect them to Kotlin behavior.
  • Build multi-screen apps that use device capabilities safely.
  • Store data locally and connect Android apps to Firebase and MySQL APIs.
  • Use lifecycle-aware background work, audio, threads, services, and receivers.

Course profile

Level: Foundation to intermediate

Prerequisites: Basic programming logic and familiarity with using a computer.

References:

Android StudioKotlin ProgrammingAndroid SDK DocumentationFirebase Documentation

Course duration: Follow the schedule provided by your instructor; no fixed duration was supplied.
